Hero.subtitle: Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation · Rwanda
Hero.title: Driven by Compassion. Empowering Communities. Creating Lasting Impact.
Hero.description: We work with Rwanda's most vulnerable communities — protecting the environment, strengthening livelihoods, and building a more equitable future.

Mission.title_mission: Serving Communities. Protecting Nature. Building Futures.
Mission.desc_mission: Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation was established to serve Rwanda's most vulnerable — those living in poverty, women and children, youth, the elderly, and socially disadvantaged groups. We work across environmental conservation, education, community health, and sustainable water management, always in partnership with the communities we serve.
Mission.quote_who: "Driven by compassion. Rooted in community. Focused on lasting impact."
Mission.desc_who: Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation (JEF) is a public-interest, non-profit foundation established to promote community well-being, protect the environment, and support sustainable development across Rwanda. Guided by values of human dignity, integrity, partnership, and equity, we work with vulnerable groups — including people with limited financial resources, women and children in poverty, youth, adolescents, and socially disadvantaged communities — to generate lasting social impact.

FocusAreas.area1_desc: Supporting vulnerable groups — teen mothers, the elderly, and low-income households — through humanitarian support, capacity-building, and livelihood initiatives.
FocusAreas.area2_desc: Protecting Rwanda's rivers, wetlands, and ecosystems through tree planting, buffer zone conservation, and community-led climate awareness.
FocusAreas.area3_desc: Expanding access to education and practical skills for youth and disadvantaged groups through scholarships, mentorship, and partnerships with training institutions.
FocusAreas.area4_desc: Protecting and sustainably managing water resources through community water projects, conservation training, and safe water access support.

Impact.title: Join Us in Building a Better Future
Impact.desc: As a new foundation, every contribution matters. Whether you donate, volunteer, or simply share our mission — you are helping build the foundation of something that will outlast all of us. Join us in Rusizi District and beyond.

About.header_subtitle: Driven by compassion. Rooted in community. Focused on lasting impact.
About.who_title: A foundation built on compassion, action, and impact.
About.who_desc1: Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation (EF) is a public-interest, non-profit foundation established to promote community well-being, protect the environment, and support sustainable development across Rwanda.
About.who_desc2: Guided by values of human dignity, integrity, partnership and collaboration, social responsibility, and equity & inclusion, the Foundation works with vulnerable groups, including people with limited financial resources, women and children in poverty, youth, adolescents, and other socially disadvantaged groups.
About.who_desc3: EF carries out activities in humanitarian support, environmental conservation, water resource management, education and vocational training, and community well-being initiatives, including sports, nutrition, and hygiene awareness. The Foundation collaborates with public institutions, private-sector partners, civil society, and community groups to implement projects that generate lasting social impact and contribute directly to Rwanda's development goals.
About.mission_desc: To promote the well-being of communities, protect the environment, and support sustainable development.
About.vision_desc: A healthy, empowered, and environmentally responsible society where all people, especially the most vulnerable, have the opportunity to thrive and contribute to sustainable development.
About.v1_desc: We act with transparency, responsibility, and ethical integrity in all our programmes, partnerships, and resource use.
About.v2_desc: We place people at the heart of our work, promoting compassion, respect, and dignity for all individuals and communities we serve.
About.v3_desc: We are committed to positive social impact by acting responsibly, promoting ethical practices, and contributing to community well‑well-being.
About.v4_desc: We work closely with communities, institutions, and development partners to deliver inclusive and locally driven solutions.
About.v5_desc: We ensure equal opportunities and meaningful participation for all, with special focus on women, youth, children, and vulnerable groups.
About.exist_title: Addressing Today's Challenges with Tomorrow's Solutions
About.exist_desc: Communities across Rwanda — particularly in areas like Rusizi District — face overlapping challenges: environmental degradation, water stress, limited educational and economic opportunities, and insufficient social protection for the most vulnerable. Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation was created not to offer temporary relief, but to build lasting systems that empower communities to sustain their own progress long after our programmes conclude.
About.approach_item1: Bottom-up solutions — We design programs with communities, not just for them.
About.approach_item2: Holistic sustainability — Every intervention is designed to create lasting change, not dependency.
About.approach_item3: Protecting the vulnerable — Women, children, youth, and the elderly are at the center of all we do.
About.approach_item4: Gender equality — We actively promote women’s participation and leadership in all programs.
About.approach_item5: Inclusive management — Local voices shape how programs are run and measured.
About.cta_desc: Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation is at the beginning of its journey. Your early support — financial or otherwise — directly shapes what we are able to build. Join us now, when your contribution has the most impact.

Projects.header_subtitle: Seven programmes. One mission: to uplift the vulnerable and protect the environment.
Projects.intro_title: Our Work, Grounded in Rwanda's Reality
Projects.intro_desc: Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation operates across seven programme areas, each designed to address a specific and interconnected challenge facing Rwanda's most vulnerable communities. Our work in Rusizi District represents our first integrated project — bringing these programmes to life simultaneously to maximize impact for at least 12,000 direct beneficiaries.
Projects.p1_desc: We provide targeted assistance to vulnerable groups — including teen mothers, women, adolescents, the elderly, and low-income households — through humanitarian support, capacity-building, and livelihood initiatives that improve living conditions.
Projects.p1_act4: Social assistance programs for teen mothers and the elderly
Projects.p2_desc: Our environmental programme promotes climate resilience and ecosystem protection across Rwanda. We work with communities to preserve river and lake buffer zones, restore degraded land, and build local knowledge around sustainable land and water management.
Projects.p2_act2: Protection of river and lake buffer zones
Projects.p2_act4: Environmental education in schools and communities
Projects.p2_act6: Support for sustainable land and water management
Projects.p3_desc: We strengthen access to education and practical skills for youth and disadvantaged groups, creating pathways to employment and self-sufficiency through scholarships, mentorship, and partnerships with training institutions.
Projects.p3_act2: School support for children in poverty
Projects.p3_act3: Vocational training in technical and practical skills
Projects.p3_act5: Partnerships with training institutions to improve employability
Projects.p4_desc: Clean, safe, and sustainable water is foundational to community health and resilience. Our water programme protects water sources, trains communities in safe water management, and supports projects that improve access to reliable water.
Projects.p4_act3: Training in safe water use and management
Projects.p4_act4: Support for WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene) initiatives
Projects.p5_desc: We improve public health from the ground up — through prevention, awareness, and community outreach. Our health programme prioritizes hygiene, nutrition, and healthy lifestyles in the communities that need it most.
Projects.p5_act4: Initiatives promoting healthy lifestyles in vulnerable communities
Projects.p6_desc: Young people are Rwanda's future — and our Youth Empowerment programme makes sure they have a voice in shaping it. We invest in leadership, entrepreneurship, and civic engagement so that youth can lead their own communities forward.
Projects.p6_act2: Volunteer networks and community service initiatives
Projects.p6_act4: Civic engagement and community accountability programmes
Projects.p7_desc: Sport is a powerful tool for social cohesion and wellbeing. Our sports programme creates spaces for communities to come together, stay healthy, and engage with important social messages through the universal language of play.
Projects.p7_act1: Community sports events and youth tournaments
Projects.p7_act3: Awareness campaigns combining sports with health and social messaging
Projects.p7_act4: Inclusive sports programmes for girls and youth with disabilities
Projects.rusizi_title: Strengthening Community Well-Being, Environmental Protection, and Sustainable Water Management in Rusizi District
Projects.rusizi_desc: Rusizi District faces environmental degradation, water stress, sanitation challenges, and limited livelihood opportunities for youth and vulnerable households. Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation is implementing a 24-month integrated project to protect the environment, promote sustainable water use, and strengthen community well-being through education, empowerment, and resilience-building.
Projects.rusizi_focus_val: Environmental conservation, WASH, youth empowerment, community health, sports, and local sustainability
Projects.rusizi_fund_val: Open to national, bilateral, multilateral donors, foundations, and private-sector partners
Projects.cta_desc: As a new foundation with ambitious goals, we need partners, donors, and volunteers who believe in community-driven change. Your support — at any level — helps turn these programmes from plans into impact.
